description: MainActivity.java defines an Android activity that serves as the main launcher for an application. It sets up a fragment for drop target functionality, manages options menu for toggling logs, and initializes a logging chain for debugging and info purposes.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: MainActivity is the entry point activity that manages the main user interface, including the fragment for drop targets and log display.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets the content view, and initializes the DropTargetFragment if this is the first creation.

methods.name: onCreateOptionsMenu
methods.description: Inflates the options menu from resource.

methods.name: onPrepareOptionsMenu
methods.description: Configures the visibility and title of the log toggle menu item based on current UI state.

methods.name: onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles selections on the options menu, toggling the log view display.

methods.name: initializeLogging
methods.description: Sets up the logging chain, wrapping Android logs, adding filters, and linking with a log fragment for display.
